New candidate: Ingredients Bar (UK) Cream Powder, real spray-dried dairy cream powder, printed fat 75 g/100 g and full ingredient list, retail 200 g pack, IN_STOCK. Kept a LEAD because the seller's delivery page only states that international delivery is charged at checkout and never names the country (owner rule 2). BulkSupplements, whose nation list does name Uruguay (and which supplies the FRU and INU rows here), sells no cream powder. | Re-checked 2026-09-17 (close-americas): still LEAD_ONLY. No local dairy cream powder was found, and no cross-border seller that makes a real delivery statement naming this country sells one (bulksupplements has none in its catalogue; gourmet-versand has none; Modernist Pantry names no destinations; Keto Store NZ ships only inside New Zealand). The only candidate with a printed dairy composition remains the UK Ingredients Bar 75 % powder, whose delivery page names no country.
